title: R Draconis — a pulsating giant star
plain_result: Not measured yet. 1635 SPHEREx pictures of this variable star are available in the Time Machine; measuring how its brightness changes needs one brightness per picture after removing its colour, which we have not done. The counts are for the whole patch of sky, not for the star itself.

numbers.label: Flagged changes, one detector at a time

method_note: Counts use the same rule as the 20-patch test (groups of ≥ 2 pixels beyond 5σ).
